descripcion_geo: The 'lowlands' between the mountains of Judah and the Philistine coastal plain; land of gentle hills and fertile valleys.
importancia_estrategica: Buffer zone between Israel and Philistines; scene of battles and the story of Samson.

historias.titulo: Samson in the valleys of the Shephelah
historias.descripcion: Samson's exploits take place in the valleys of Shephelah (Timnat, Ashkelon, Lehi), the border land between Israel and the Philistines.

historias.titulo: The Valley of Elah and David and Goliath
historias.descripcion: The valley of Elah in Shephelah is the scene of the duel between David and the giant Goliath.

historias.titulo: The cities of Shephelah in Josiah's reform
historias.descripcion: Josiah extends his religious reform to the cities of Shephelah, destroying places of pagan worship.

personajes.descripcion: His adventures and battles against the Philistines took place in the Shephela.
He was a shepherd in Bethlehem and fought in the valleys of Shephela before becoming king.
Born in Moreset-Gath in La Sefela; contemporary prophet by Isaiah.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Border land and interaction with the Philistines; Its valleys were battlefields that forged the military identity of Israel.

judaismo.descripcion: The valley of Elah in the Shephelah was the scene of the final confrontation between Israel and the Philistines, represented in the David-Goliath duel.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The valley of Elah in the Shephelah was the scene of the final confrontation between Israel and the Philistines, represented in the David-Goliath duel.
